This satisfies all the requirements: `db.py` and the models were untouched by me (they'd already been renamed `fecha`→`inicio` by another concurrent agent, which I adapted to), the filter is applied in SQL via the new `app/consultas.py` module, invalid `desde` returns 422, missing `desde` preserves old behavior, and the new tests cover all acceptance criteria.

Task complete. `GET /reservas?desde=AAAA-MM-DD` now filters reservations via SQL in the new `app/consultas.py` module (`listar_reservas_desde`), with invalid formats returning 422 and no-param behavior unchanged. I adapted to a concurrent rename of the reservation field from `fecha` to `inicio` done by another agent working in the same repo. All 8 tests in `test_reservas.py` pass; the only failures in the full suite are in `test_export.py`, from an unrelated in-progress task by another agent.
